name: voxel-realms-rpg
description: 3D Open-World Voxel MMORPG, Castle Warfare Strategy, Single-Instance 20Hz WebSocket Siege Server & Anti-Cheat Authority (Simulated Regional Topology + Cloud SQL/Firestore), Four-Path Immortal Cultivation, 6-Tier Cosmic Hierarchy (COSMIC_LIMITS: 1 White Page -> 100 Overvoids -> Infinity Realities), D3 Cosmological Tree, Auto-Populating Open-World Lore Codex, 12 Dynastic Annals & 10^100-Word Akashic Stream built with React 19, Three.js 0.187, three-mesh-bvh, cannon-es, simplex-noise, D3.js, TypeScript, and C++20 SIMD guardrails (20/11/2026).
author: Voxel Realms RPG Team <creatergame31@gmail.com>

scripts.test: tsx --test src/game/*.test.ts src/lib/*.test.ts src/db/*.test.ts src/server/*.test.ts firestore.rules.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: tsx --test --experimental-test-coverage src/game/*.test.ts src/lib/*.test.ts src/db/*.test.ts src/server/*.test.ts firestore.rules.test.ts
scripts.validate: npm run lockfile:verify && npm run lint && npm run lint:rules && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
